components.name: Directional coupler 2x2 (~50/50 at 1550 nm)
components.description: Coupled-mode-theory model, 9 um coupling length, wavelength-dependent coupling, 0.1 dB excess loss.

components.name: Unbalanced Mach-Zehnder interferometer (dL = 40 um)
components.description: Two ideal 50/50 couplers, arm lengths 50/90 um, 0.3 dB total excess loss. Spectral fringes across the C-band.

components.name: All-pass ring resonator (R = 10 um)
components.description: All-pass microring, radius 10 um, self-coupling t=0.98, transfer function T=(t-a*e^-iphi)/(1-t*a*e^-iphi).

components.name: Straight waveguide (100 um)
components.description: Single-mode strip waveguide, 500 x 220 nm, 100 um long. Lossy transmission-line model with linear dispersion.

components.name: Y-branch splitter 1x2
components.description: Ideal 50/50 power splitter with 0.2 dB excess loss and 5 um effective path length.
